title: Decouple a tightly coupled Store
description: Store tracks stock levels and directly calls specific objects (a logger, a notifier) whenever stock changes. Each dependent is hardcoded into Store, so the class knows exactly who reacts to its state.
hints: Define an Observer interface with an update(String event, Object data) method
Add a List<Observer> field to Store and addObserver(Observer o) / removeObserver(Observer o) methods
When stock changes, call each observer's update() instead of hard-coding specific actions
issues: Store directly calls specific dependent objects when its state changes
Adding a new reaction to a stock change requires editing Store itself
overallGoal: Use the Observer pattern to decouple Store from its dependents, so any number of observers can react to stock changes without Store knowing who they are.
goals: Store knows nothing about its dependents beyond the Observer interface
New observers can be added or removed at runtime without changing Store
All registered observers are notified whenever stock changes
